text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 8) 2021.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 23 Disember 2021 hingga 31 Disember 2021.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kambing biri-biri import bertulang

2. Ayam belanda import

3. Kepak ayam

4. Lada benggala hijau

5. Babi hidup

6. Daging babi (perut)

7. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 15 Disember 2021

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/XII]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 8) ORDER 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 8) Order 2021.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles

for the period from 23 December 2021 to 31 December 2021.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Imported bone-in mutton

2. Imported turkey

3. Chicken wing

4. Green capsicum

5. Live pig

6. Pork (belly)

7. Pork (lean and fat)

Made 15 December 2021

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/XII]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Minister of Domestic Trade and Consumer Affairs
